gate_type: PLANNING/REVIEW gate — Post-G16 Platform Workstream Independence Review (G17A)
objective: Produce an evidence-grounded, deterministic separation between VF workstreams that genuinely depend on unresolved plant semantic authority (T108 -> DIST-P108, STILL_INSUFFICIENT) and platform capability work that can proceed independently. Inspect actual accepted repo state through G16 (G4 Coordinator/ExecutableParticipant/BoundaryTransfer, G7 run-control, G14A projection, G14B federation, G15 evaluation, G16 readiness artifact, frontend/inspection surfaces, replay/run-identity/provenance). Classify every required workstream with exactly one of CAN_PROCEED_INDEPENDENTLY / BLOCKED_BY_PIM_EVIDENCE / SHOULD_WAIT_FOR_RUNTIME_EXPANSION, each with a full decision record (current repo readiness, dependencies, plant-truth-required flag, architecture risk if done now, rationale, priority, future model Flash or Pro). Distinguish PIM_AUTHORITATIVE_TOPOLOGY (still blocked for T108->DIST-P108) from VF_SCENARIO_ASSUMED_TOPOLOGY (may be a future bounded synthetic-reference implementation gate; explicit/versioned/provenanced/reversible; never promoted to site truth). Choose exactly one smallest next VF implementation gate satisfying: independent of unresolved T108->DIST-P108 semantic authority; materially reduces whole-plant federation risk; does not broaden SH-WTP runtime authorization; requires no new plant physics/topology truth; preserves CompositionGraph != execution order; preserves coupling policy as orchestration policy; does not redesign G4. No runtime, UI, graph, PIM, projection, or federation implementation in G17A. No DIST-P108/T110/Line2/chemical/electrical/automation runtime.
explicit_non_objectives: No Line 2 / chemical / electrical / automation runtime
No Gauss-Seidel / iterative / multirate policy implementation
required_deliverables: configs/vnext/shwtp/shwtp_workstream_independence_review.json (machine-readable workstream classification matrix + dependency matrix + recommended next gate + blocked/deferred list + architecture invariants + no-runtime-authorization statement)
tests/test_vnext_g17a_workstream_review.py (planning tests proving G17A did not change runtime behavior)
forbidden_actions: Modify PIM or re-pin PIM artifacts
Create DIST-P108 runtime or T108->DIST ports/binding
Create T110 / Line2 / chemical / electrical / automation runtime
Add Gauss-Seidel / iterative / multirate policy implementation
Redesign G4 without a repo-proven blocker
Start the recommended next implementation gate
stop_conditions: The only meaningful next step requires a new product/physics/architecture decision not supported by evidence
The recommended next gate would require changing frozen G4/runtime semantics
PIM must change or be re-pinned
A workstream classification would require broadening site/runtime authority
Selecting a next gate requires plant physics/topology truth that is not available
